purpose: Organize qualification and empirical work into independently auditable blocks.
global_rules: A remains the only executable treatment until its real-agent preflight is qualified.
B1 and C1 contracts may be tested, but their operational mechanisms remain disabled.
A blocked infrastructure outcome is not an agent failure.
No candidate advances on smoke evidence alone.

blocks.name: contracts-and-matrix
blocks.scope: schemas, identities, strata, outcomes, artifact paths

blocks.name: compatibility
blocks.scope: model query, action parser, Git Bash, Docker, hardened adapter
blocks.output: qualified, blocked, or incompatible probe record
blocks.stop_when: one complete response and required runtime checks are observed

blocks.name: difficulty-smoke
blocks.scope: T0, T1, and T2 deterministic fixtures
blocks.execution: serial fixture runs with frozen identity

blocks.name: candidate-qualification
blocks.scope: model x harness x stratum cells
blocks.stop_when: candidate set for the next comparison wave is frozen

blocks.name: baseline-A
blocks.execution: only the predeclared tasks and identity
blocks.stop_when: all tasks are terminal or the declared blocker is exhausted

blocks.name: stratified-exploration
blocks.input: Block 3 candidate set and accepted baseline evidence
blocks.execution: same authority and identity within each comparison
blocks.stop_when: the predeclared exploratory allocation is complete

blocks.name: mechanism-gate
blocks.scope: authorization of operational B1 or C1
blocks.execution: review and acceptance; no automatic promotion
blocks.stop_when: an independent acceptance decision is recorded
